    {
      "keystrokes": "python3 /app/extract_smart.py > /app/moves_smart.txt 2>&1; cat /app/moves_smart.txt

      "keystrokes": "cat > /app/extract_movecount.py << 'PYEOF'
import os, re, glob

ocr_files = sorted(glob.glob('/app/ocr_kf/*.txt'), key=lambda x: float(re.search(r'(\d+\.\d+)\.txt', x).group(1)))

for fpath in ocr_files:
    fname = os.path.basename(fpath)
    with open(fpath, 'r', errors='replace') as f:
        text = f.read()
    # Look for Moves: N in the text
    m = re.search(r'Moves:\s*(\d+)', text)
    moves = m.group(1) if m else '?'
    # Get last > command
    cmds = [l.strip()[1:].strip() for l in text.splitlines() if l.strip().startswith('>') and len(l.strip()) > 1]
    last_cmd = cmds[-1] if cmds else ''
    print(f"{fname}\tMoves: {moves}\tCmd: {last_cmd}")
PYEOF
python3 /app/extract_movecount.py
",

    }
